question: How many fleet lakes can be matched to REAL contour data by geometry?
finding: 140 fleet lakes verified spatially (134 from 20 contour sources + 6 TWDB area-capacity tables); scout name candidates mostly confirmed, 3 rejected (polygon extent mismatch), 24 weak-overlap + 6 embedded-water-body pairs rejected; 59 name-only (index/catalog sources)

question: How many verified lakes have adequate truth (data-quality flag)?
finding: 137 truth rows: tier A 76, tier B 26, tier C 35 (partial lakes, >10 ft contour steps, datum/top truncation); analysis sets A (n=76) and A+B (n=102)

question: Is the contour-to-shares method accurate? (real TWDB contours vs exact area-capacity tables, 18 lakes)
finding: native 1-2 ft ladders: MAE 0.010-0.013 share; 5-ft ladder MAE 0.015-0.026; 10-ft ladder MAE 0.020-0.070 with a +0.05-0.07 bias at <=6 ft (overstates shallow)

question: Does this thread's contour method agree with the terrain thread's independent MN extraction?
finding: yes except Minnetonka (fleet polygon 55.6 km2 vs DNR pool 66.7 km2)

question: GLOBathy Dmax vs contour max depth (modeled-Dmax lakes only)
finding: no skill over a constant; regresses to the middle
numbers: n=73 Spearman 0.18 CI -0.08..0.41; within 2x 0.66 vs constant 0.62; median ratio 1.14

question: GLOBathy A(h) share of area shallower than 1.8 m (5.9 ft) vs contour truth
numbers: n=76 MAE 0.133 vs constant 0.120; Spearman 0.01 CI -0.24..0.27; AUC top-third 0.51

question: Which cheap proxy predicts broad-shallow lakes (top third of share <6 ft)?
finding: none reliably; best is HydroLAKES/NID mean depth (AUC 0.62, CI spans 0.5); polygon proxies 0.47-0.56; leave-one-state-out ridge models do not beat the constant

question: Ceiling: would knowing mean depth exactly be enough?
finding: yes - true mean depth ranks broad-shallow lakes well, so any route to mean depth (not Dmax) is the lever
numbers: oracle mean depth AUC 0.90 [0.83,0.97] rho 0.76; oracle Dmax AUC 0.79

question: Within-lake: do 3DEP shoreline slope + distance predict where the 0-6 ft zone is?
finding: slope is a real but modest within-lake signal; distance from shore does most of the work
numbers: per-lake rho(slope_10_60, share<=6ft in 100 m band) mean -0.24 CI -0.32..-0.16, 33/44 lakes negative; slope-aware mask IoU 0.439 vs constant-width 0.403 (delta CI 0.005..0.073); AUC dist 0.818 -> dist+slope 0.822
